title: Fixed Domed Drum and Chain Weight Handwheel
description: One newly authored complete static uninscribed prayer-wheel-inspired exterior. A whole long turned wooden-look handle carries a single axial spindle and broad lower collar beneath one full cylindrical case with an integrated domed-lid exterior and plain narrow rim bands. Six separate complete closed oval links form one short alternating-plane side tether ending in one full neck-and-rounded-weight body. All link holes are genuine open space; small intentional overlaps root neighboring links in this fixed pose. Every numeric profile, loop path, placement and weight shape is new, not a cabasa cylinder with bead loops removed, a shallow pellet rattle case, a spinning top or an extracted chain accessory. The complete handle butt is the finite ground datum; ten closed editable components and four opaque PBR roles, metres native Z up, one model zero scenes. Broad category inspiration acknowledges Tibetan Buddhist prayer wheels, but this plain decorative exterior omits sacred inscriptions, icons, scrolls and internal drum cavity, and does not reproduce a particular museum object, regional ornament, historical form, material identity or ritual authenticity. The cylinder is an opaque closed display solid, not an accessible vessel. No prayer efficacy, ceremonial instruction, spinning, bearing clearance, chain articulation, dynamic suspension, balance, manufacture, hand fit, strength or safety capability made or verified. No rig, animation or interaction.
